Because this is in downtown Boston  the contractor can only work on weekends. Last weeks Red Sox parade pushed the topping until this Saturday.     The city apologizes for the inconvenience this necessary work has caused.    Sincerely     Mark Cardarelli  Supervisor of Utility Coordination and Compliance  Boston Public Works Department  [removed] Office  [removed] Cell
